message.content: The image shows a large pool in the middle of a complex of buildings. The pool is rectangular and has a small ledge around it. It is surrounded by buildings on all sides, with a staircase leading down to the pool from the right side. The buildings are multi-story and have balconies with glass railings. They are made of light-colored stone or concrete and have a modern design. In the background, there is a clear blue sky. The overall atmosphere suggests a luxurious and relaxing environment, possibly a resort or a high-end residential complex.
